howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF up to 500 MB that you serve over the web or via a CDN.

howto.name: Linearize and download
howto.text: Click Optimize. qpdf reorganizes the file structure so the first page renders before the whole document downloads — perfect for inline embeds and CDN-hosted PDFs.

faq.a: It reorganizes the PDF byte layout so the first page's objects come first in the file. A byte-range-aware viewer can then start rendering the first page while the rest still downloads.
Expect a small change, often an increase: linearization adds hint tables for the viewer and reorders the objects. Two small test files each grew by about 9 %.

faq.q: Do I need this for a PDF served from my own server?
faq.a: Mainly for large PDFs viewed inline in a browser, where the first page can appear before the download finishes. A small PDF downloads quickly either way.
